verdict.rationale: Ollama clearly runs many open models (Gemma 4 in its docs, models pulled from HF or its registry). Community reports show an MoE model (qwen3.5:35b-a3b) running via 'ollama run' and confirm multimodal support works, but nothing in the pack shows breadth across hundreds of architectures. Missing for 10: evidence of embedding-model support, first-party documentation of the breadth ('hundreds') of supported architectures, and first-party documentation of MoE and multimodal support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
A new model on HF or Ollama registry? One 'ollama pull' and it's available.
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
